setting: Kofi cooks on a food truck with John and Priya and texts Tex from his phone. Tex has his Context notes, Google Calendar, a reminder tool and the web. His notes say his Saturday truck shift starts at 11 am and that his sister Ama's birthday is Saturday the 21st. Tex's replies on Monday and Tuesday are from before it paid attention to how Kofi writes.
title: Kofi and Tex: catching his way of texting

msgs.text: yo can u remind me to call ama tonight
Sure. I'll remind you tonight at 7 PM to call Ama.
bet
whats a good gift for a sister who has everything lol

A few ideas: an experience you can do together, like a cooking class or concert tickets, a framed photo of the two of you, or something from a local shop she likes. Let me know if you'd like me to look up options near you.
nah im good
ugh truck generator died again
Sorry to hear that. Would you like me to find a repair shop nearby?
nah john got it
u up

must: answer in Kofi's own register: lowercase, a few words, no full stop
never: carry on in the capitalized, full-sentence style of Tex's earlier replies in this chat

never: write a capitalized full sentence like its earlier replies
